pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped dark brown patches with serrated and jagged edge gradients. Patches on the lower hindquarter are smaller and more densely clustered than those on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are clearly defined where three or more patch vertices converge, with narrow pixel thickness between neighboring patches.
